name: Hot100.ai

sources.title: Homepage — weekly chart of trending AI projects; JS-rendered (empty to non-JS fetch)

Rules & Scoring (search-indexed) — pipeline: Submit → Admin Review → 7-day Launchpad voting → Flambo AI judges → weekly Top 100 (AI score ≥7.0); Final Score = (AI Score × 10) + (Votes × 0.5); max 4 weeks on chart then archive
About — discovery/ranking/index layer for AI projects; weekly Monday chart refresh

SubmitMap walkthrough — verified form details: Google sign-in required, submitter-role dropdown includes 'agent or automated submission', title ≤100 chars, summary ≤200, builder-stack pickers, security-practices tick; outbound links followed; ~1,000 projects compete for 100 slots; $19 tier buys discovery, not ranking

conditions: Submission is free but requires Google sign-in and passes an admin review
Chart visibility is merit-gated: only projects with Flambo AI score ≥7.0 plus community votes make the weekly Top 100; ~1,000 projects compete for 100 slots
A $19 paid tier exists for extra discovery — their copy says it buys discovery, not ranking
requirements: Google account sign-in (the SUBMIT button does nothing signed out; /submit bounces back to the chart)
AI-built project fit — the form asks which model, which coding agent/IDE, and which stack/hosting built it

Required: who-is-submitting dropdown (founder/team, on behalf of founder, community member, or 'agent or automated submission' — agents are explicitly allowed but must be declared), title ≤100 chars, summary ≤200 chars, security-best-practices confirmation tick
Optional: thumbnail (PNG/JPEG), stage dropdown, GitHub/website/X/LinkedIn links, up-to-2 picks each for model, IDE/agent, hosting
preparation: Your honest builder stack: model/provider, IDE/coding agent, hosting (the chart's differentiator)
If submitting via an agent: declare it in the role dropdown — honesty is a form field
workflow: Sign in with Google on hot100.ai
Open /submit and declare who is submitting
Fill title, URL, summary, builder-stack pickers, thumbnail, stage, links, security tick
Submit → redirects to a builder project page showing 'Awaiting Review'
On admin approval: 7 days in the Launchpad collecting votes → Flambo AI judges → chart entry if AI score ≥7.0; archives after 4 weeks
watchFor: Submission does not equal chart placement — most approved projects sit in the Launchpad/archive without cracking the Top 100
Outbound links are followed per SubmitMap's check, but only if the listing goes live
Do not impersonate 'founder' if submitting as an agent — the form has an explicit honest option for automated submissions
$19 tier only buys discovery; the ranking formula (AI score + votes) is not purchasable per their own claims
Site is JS-rendered — use a real browser for the whole flow
countsAsLive: The project has a public page on hot100.ai (Launchpad or archive); the strong signal is appearing in the weekly Top-100 chart rows with rank movement indicators
unknowns: What the $19 discovery tier concretely adds
Vote-weighting/anti-gaming details beyond the published formula
